reading.workResult: Fail-closed admission passed for branch main, wake source chatgpt-scheduled-task, the active 2026-08-25 Reading window and the worker's available GitHub read/write, file-editing and primary-source research capabilities. The unique Reading Wake Receipt was committed and fetched before Runtime business work. Global serial reconciliation found Discovery and Queue closed and Reading as the earliest due unfinished task; a repository process kick triggered ordered reconciliation, the scheduler durably opened Reading at 11:04:29, and the native claim workflow persisted Worker Claimed at 11:05:49 before substantive Deep Reading. The native control/claim validation chain ran repository Runtime validation and deterministic worker-prompt validation against the current generated prompt before substantive reading. Skill 03 then completed primary-source reading for all three same-day P0 objects and produced exactly three durable Reading Notes. Q-20260825-01 verifies a project-configuration trust boundary in Codex: when credential brokering is effectively enabled, project-level shell snapshot/profile startup controls and protected broker/provider environment keys including ZDOTDIR and BASH_ENV are suppressed, while the disabled branch preserves ordinary project settings; this is bounded project-layer isolation rather than universal credential isolation. Q-20260825-02 verifies resumable Session write reconciliation in the OpenAI Agents SDK: pending writes are persisted, authoritative history is fingerprinted before the next model call, an already-committed append is not replayed, an unchanged history may be appended, and any changed/ambiguous history fails closed; the implementation explicitly lacks distributed CAS and therefore does not prove distributed exactly-once persistence. Q-20260825-03 verifies concurrency-aware Codex startup rollout migration: apparently empty rollouts are reread under the writer lock, busy rollouts remain retryable, and paths moved by archive/compression are rediscovered before migration proceeds; terminal failures do not hold the cursor forever but still require explicit recovery. Reading performed no Research Analysis, article writing, visualization, Production or Publication and used no prior-day Runtime artifact as a business input.
reading.workResult_zh: 针对 main 分支、chatgpt-scheduled-task 唤醒源、2026-08-25 有效 Reading 时段，以及当前 Worker 实际具备的 GitHub 读写、文件编辑与一手来源研究能力，Fail-Closed Admission 通过。任何 Runtime 业务工作前，唯一 Reading Wake Receipt 已提交并重新 Fetch 核验。全局串行 Reconciliation 确认 Discovery 与 Queue 已收口，Reading 是最早到期未收口任务；通过仓库 Process Kick 触发有序对账后，Scheduler 于 11:04:29 持久打开 Reading 执行槽，原生 Claim Workflow 于 11:05:49 持久写入 Worker Claimed，之后才开始实质 Deep Reading。原生控制/Claim 校验链在实质阅读前对当前 Generated Prompt 执行 Runtime Validation 与确定性的 Worker Prompt Validation。随后 Skill 03 对当天三个 P0 对象全部完成一手来源深读，并恰好生成三份持久 Reading Note。Q-20260825-01 核验 Codex 项目配置的信任边界：Credential Brokering 实际启用时，项目层 Shell Snapshot、Profile Startup 控制以及包括 ZDOTDIR、BASH_ENV 在内的受保护 Broker/Provider 环境键会被抑制，而 Disabled 分支保留普通项目设置；该结论仅是项目层隔离，不是所有凭据状态的普遍隔离。Q-20260825-02 核验 OpenAI Agents SDK 的 Resumable Session Write 对账：Pending Write 被持久化，在下一次 Model Call 前读取并指纹化权威 History；已提交 Append 不重放，History 未变化时可补写，History 已变化或存在歧义时 Fail Closed；实现明确没有分布式 CAS，因此不能声称分布式 Exactly-Once Persistence。Q-20260825-03 核验 Codex 启动期 Rollout Migration 的并发恢复：看似为空的 Rollout 会在 Writer Lock 下重读，Busy Rollout 保持后续可重试，Archive/Compression 导致路径移动时会重新发现当前路径后再迁移；Terminal Failure 不会永久阻塞 Cursor，但仍需要显式恢复。Reading 未执行 Research Analysis、文章写作、可视化、Production 或 Publication，也未把前一日 Runtime Artifact 作为业务输入。
